limits: the other half of the same over-refusal, and it is the price of a membership test that must answer in BOTH directions: `rm -rf team-kits` names every protected file under it without spelling one, so a candidate naming an ANCESTOR -- a bare `..`, a drive letter, the repo root -- is read as a write to everything beneath. Measured: `cp -r docs ..` is rc 2. Nothing gets through; what it costs is a refused line with a relative target above the repo. The way round it: name the target absolutely and outside the repo.
